title: Third Coast Foundry (SF) — UChicago Polsky fireside on Incorruptible
summary: Third Coast Foundry hosts an Incorruptible fireside chat for University of Chicago alumni in SF, co-produced by the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship. Karthee Madasamy (Managing Partner, MFV Partners) reports the highlight: taking on Milton Friedman's shareholder-primacy argument in a room full of UChicago folks — the very Hyde Park lineage of the idea Eric's trying to unseat.
blockquote: The fun part for me — asking him about Milton Friedman and shareholder primacy in a room full of UChicago folks. The very idea he's challenging came out of Hyde Park. He didn't dodge, and the room didn't either.
attribution: Third Coast Foundry / UChicago Polsky Center
